charts.title: Kepler-42 c: orbits around Kepler-42
charts.description: The orbits of Kepler-42's planets in this map from above, to scale, with Kepler-42 c highlighted and the direction to Earth down. Each orbit is the one the app draws, from the published period, a/R*, eccentricity and argument of periastron; the star is a marker, not to scale.

metadata.orbitSource: Mann et al. 2017 (2017AJ....153..267M), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table (pl_refname MANN_ET_AL__2017): P 0.45328731 d

charts.title: Kepler-42 c: its transit
charts.description: Kepler-42 c crossing its star, as TESS recorded it: 3 sectors (75, 81, 82) of the SPOC pipeline's 2-minute light curves of TIC 63126862, each transit divided by a straight line fitted to the light either side and folded onto the orbit the app draws, then averaged in 4-minute bins. Error bars are each bin's standard error.
notes: Folded on the app's orbit; 4-min bins.
Bars: standard error of each bin.
